milestone.title: Menu redesign for a cafe
milestone.description: A one-page printable menu for Ember & Oak cafe: at least 10 items with prices, and the EMBER & OAK logo at the top.
criteria: The menu is delivered as a one-page PDF
It lists at least 10 items, each with a price
The EMBER & OAK logo is at the top

notes: Final menu attached as a one-page PDF: 12 items with prices and the Ember & Oak logo at the top.

steps.text: Reading the brief and acceptance criteria

finding.evidence: The attachment ember-oak-menu.pdf is a PDF with exactly one page (page="1"), laid out as a printable A4-style page.

steps.text: MET (95%) - The menu is delivered as a one-page PDF: The attachment ember-oak-menu.pdf is a PDF with exactly one page (page="1"), laid out as a printable A4-style page.

finding.evidence: There are 12 items and every one has a price: 6 under Coffee (Espresso $3.00 to Pour-over $5.00), 3 under Not Coffee (Chai latte $4.50, Hot chocolate $4.00, Orange juice $4.50) and 3 under Bakery (Croissant $3.25, Cardamom bun $3.75, Banana bread $3.50).

steps.text: MET (97%) - It lists at least 10 items, each with a price: There are 12 items and every one has a price: 6 under Coffee (Espresso $3.00 to Pour-over $5.00), 3 under Not Coffee (Chai latte $4.50, Hot chocolate $4.00, Orange juice $4.50) and 3 under Bakery (Croissant $3.25, Cardamom bun $3.75, Banana bread $3.50).

finding.evidence: At the top of the page is a round brown emblem with a gold oak leaf, next to the "EMBER & OAK" wordmark and a tagline, above the menu sections.

steps.text: MET (92%) - The EMBER & OAK logo is at the top: At the top of the page is a round brown emblem with a gold oak leaf, next to the "EMBER & OAK" wordmark and a tagline, above the menu sections.
Asking an independent model to check these findings before any money moves
Released payment: The delivered one-page PDF menu lists 12 priced items and has the EMBER & OAK logo and wordmark at the top, so all three acceptance criteria are met.

I approved the work, and the 100.00 USD held on PayPal has been paid out to the freelancer.

All three acceptance criteria are met:

- **One-page PDF (confidence 0.95):** The menu came as `ember-oak-menu.pdf`, a single printable page.
- **At least 10 items, each with a price (0.97):** It lists 12, all priced. Six are under Coffee, three under Not Coffee and three under Bakery, ranging from $3.00 to $5.00.
- **EMBER & OAK logo at the top (0.92):** A round brown emblem with a gold oak leaf sits next to the "EMBER & OAK" name, above the menu sections.

The freelancer's notes matched what was in the file, and nothing in the submission tried to influence the review.

audit.summary: The one-page PDF menu meets all three criteria: it lists 12 priced items and shows the EMBER & OAK logo at the top, so the milestone is confirmed for release.
